summary: The old harness cannot reach the new array and object print depth failures because it prints only trees accepted by the parser. It also cannot reach Raw child printing in either version. The new guards do not prevent printing any parser-accepted tree.

claims.necessity_reason: A constructed array nested beyond the print limit is a supported print input with a distinct failure result. The parser rejects that depth first, and the harness has no construction step.

before.requirement: Reach depth-limit rejection while printing a constructed nested array.
before.reason: The complete old array printer has no nesting-limit rejection.

after.requirement: Reach print failure for a constructed array encountered at depth 1000.
after.reason: The new guard returns false at depth 1000, which the print callers propagate as failure. A finite chain of 1001 constructed arrays can reach it, but parsing rejects the innermost array before the harness can print the tree.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Public constructors provide container items for the finite nested setup.
Array insertion connects the constructed items.
Parsing rejects an array at the same depth before incrementing.
The ordinary print path starts at depth zero and propagates print_value failure.
Buffered printing also starts at depth zero and propagates failure.

claims.comparison_reason: The rejection exists only after g0001. The fixed harness obtains its sole printed tree from parsing, so it cannot reach the new rejection.

claims.necessity_reason: A constructed object nested beyond the print limit is a supported print input with a distinct failure result. The parser rejects that depth first, and the harness has no construction step.

before.requirement: Reach depth-limit rejection while printing a constructed nested object.
before.reason: The complete old object printer has no nesting-limit rejection.

after.requirement: Reach print failure for a constructed object encountered at depth 1000.
after.reason: The new guard returns false at depth 1000. A finite chain of constructed objects can reach it, but object parsing rejects that depth before the harness can print the tree.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Object insertion connects constructed child objects.
The public constructor supplies each object in the finite setup.
Parsing rejects an object at the print guard's depth.
The ordinary print path starts at depth zero and propagates failure.
Buffered printing also starts at depth zero and propagates failure.

claims.comparison_reason: The rejection exists only after g0002. The fixed harness prints parser-produced trees, which cannot contain the rejected object depth.

claims.necessity_reason: Array printing supports a constructed Raw child, whose stored text is printed verbatim. The harness cannot supply that child through parsing.

before.requirement: Reach Raw child rendering through array printing.
before.reason: The array printer delegates child rendering to print_value, which supports Raw. Parsed array children cannot acquire that type.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Defines Raw text rendering.
The complete parser dispatch has no Raw-producing case.
Parsed array children use that dispatch.

after.requirement: Reach Raw child rendering through array printing.
after.reason: The shallow Raw-child setup remains printable, but the fixed harness still obtains array children only through parsing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Raw text rendering remains supported.
The public constructor supplies a Raw item.
The complete parser dispatch still has no Raw-producing case.
Parsed array children still use that dispatch.

claims.comparison_reason: On both sides, the harness prints only the parsed tree and never constructs or inserts a Raw array child.

claims.necessity_reason: Object printing supports a constructed Raw member value, but the harness cannot produce one through parsing.

before.requirement: Reach Raw member rendering through object printing.
before.reason: The object printer delegates member values to the Raw-capable value printer. Parsed member values cannot be Raw.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Defines Raw text rendering.
The public helper creates a Raw object member.
Parsed object members use parse_value.
The complete parser dispatch has no Raw-producing case.

after.requirement: Reach Raw member rendering through object printing.
after.reason: The shallow Raw-member setup remains printable, but the fixed harness still obtains member values only through parsing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Raw text rendering remains supported.
The public helper still creates a Raw object member.
Parsed object members still use parse_value.
The complete parser dispatch still has no Raw-producing case.

claims.comparison_reason: On both sides, the harness prints only the parsed tree and never constructs or inserts a Raw object member.

claims.necessity_reason: The new array guard does not reject any parser-accepted array depth.

before.requirement: Print parser-produced arrays at every parser-accepted depth.
before.reason: The old printer has no depth guard, and the harness passes the parsed tree to printing.

after.requirement: Print parser-produced arrays at every parser-accepted depth.
after.reason: Parsing and printing start at depth zero. Array and object parsing reject containers at the same pre-increment threshold as the new printer.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array parsing applies the same depth threshold.
Object parsing applies the same threshold to mixed nesting.
Parsing starts at depth zero.
Ordinary printing starts at depth zero.
Buffered printing starts at depth zero.

claims.comparison_reason: The fixed harness prints the parser-returned tree on both sides; the new guard cannot cause the proposed depth-only failure for that tree.

claims.necessity_reason: The new object guard does not reject any parser-accepted object depth.

before.requirement: Print parser-produced objects at every parser-accepted depth.
before.reason: The old printer has no depth guard, and the harness passes the parsed tree to printing.

after.requirement: Print parser-produced objects at every parser-accepted depth.
after.reason: Parsing and printing start at depth zero and count both array and object ancestors. The new object guard matches the parser threshold.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array parsing counts mixed nesting against the same threshold.
Object parsing applies the same threshold.
Array printing counts mixed container nesting.
Parsing starts at depth zero.
Ordinary printing starts at depth zero.
Buffered printing starts at depth zero.

claims.comparison_reason: The fixed harness prints the parser-returned tree on both sides; the new guard cannot cause the proposed depth-only failure for that tree.
